notes: Proposer 8 holds Promises from acceptor 3. That is 1 of 1. A Phase-1 quorum here is 1 of 1. Phase 1 is complete.
No acceptor reported a value, so proposer 8 may propose its own. Quorum intersection says that a member of this quorum would have reported a value already chosen.
Phase 2 begins: Accept bravo at ballot 1.8 to acceptor 3.
